| [NOTE-066](../../../record/notes.d/NOTE-066.md) v2 | Backens & Duman, graphical calculus for Spekkens' toy bit | Take the maximal-knowledge fragment of Spekkens' toy bit theory with post-selected measurements, viewed as relations over {1,2,3,4}ⁿ. Completeness goes through a proof that the toy theory's binary "check-matrix" formalism coincides with the qubit stabilizer one (valid states SᵀJS = 0, valid transformations QᵀJQ = J, Lemma 3). | [NOTE-069](../../../record/notes.d/NOTE-069.md) v2 | Riehl & Shulman, type theory for synthetic ∞-categories | A three-layer type theory adds a directed interval 2 to HoTT.
